answer: A stake bond resists Sybil attacks by making each identity post collateral that is slashed when the agent misbehaves. Creating a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand bonds, so an attacker burns real capital per identity instead of spawning free copies. Like a sonnet that only works when every line is earned, the bond turns identity from a free ember anyone can scatter into timber that must be bought, stacked, and risked before it can act.
